name: Percy Tozaki
source:
Biology Major, Mathematics Minor, Year 2

At first blush, Percy's a jokester, who doesn't shy away from teasing complete strangers to high heaven. The truth, if you know him? He's quieter than one might think, and he has a rosier outlook on life than his witty nature suggests. Meet him where he is first, and he might just demonstrate.
